verifiedFacts.claim: fork_session creates a new session with a copy of history; original stays unchanged
continue_conversation resumes the most recent session in the directory and adds to it
Resuming without forking appends to the same session
input_tokens counts only tokens after the last cache breakpoint; total = cache_read + cache_creation + input_tokens
Cache writes are billed at 1.25x (5m) / 2x (1h) and reads at a reduced rate, each distinct from base input
Business logic errors, invalid input data and API failures are tool execution errors (isError: true), not protocol errors
Tool results may include structuredContent
Vertex/Agent Platform offers global, multi-region (us, eu) and regional endpoints
Regional endpoints are required for single-region data residency; multi-region routes across regions within a geography
Regional and multi-region endpoints carry a 10% premium over global
Docs note specific regional endpoints support only some (older) models; newer models use global or multi-region

issues: Version-sensitive: regional-endpoint model availability is limited (docs: Sonnet 4.6 and earlier). Option D's 'checking model availability there' covers this; keep that clause.

issues: Option A's claim ('a resumed session detects changed files') is not cleanly false: Claude Code documents system reminders noting that a previously read file changed on disk, and docs do not say this is disabled after resume. A strong candidate could pick A.
Key rests on undocumented behavior; B remains the most reliable/efficient choice but the distractor is risky.
suggestedFix: Rewrite A so its false part is unambiguous, e.g. 'Run claude --resume billing-proration and continue; the earlier tool results already reflect the merged changes.' Or reframe the stem so the developer cannot rely on automatic notices (e.g. resumed via the Agent SDK in a different host after copying the transcript).
